symptom:
An HTTP key-value server (server/main.go) accepts PUT /put?k=..&v=.. and appends the record to data/kv.log, fsyncing before it answers OK. On start it replays the log. The client stores keys, remembers which were acknowledged, and reads them all back at the end.

Observed on seed 1: the server was crashed during a disk operation at 537ms and again at 1.7s. The client reported: acknowledged write lost: k93=v93, server now answers "404 page not found". The server never logged an error.

Expected: every acknowledged write must survive crashes and restarts.
